description: Upgrade a production Kubernetes cluster from v1.27 to v1.28 following the official upgrade sequence. Cordon and drain worker nodes one at a time, upgrade control plane components (kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler) via kubeadm, then upgrade kubelet and kube-proxy on each node. Verify all existing workloads remain healthy, all nodes report Ready, and core add-ons (CoreDNS, kube-proxy) function correctly. Full etcd snapshot backup is required before any destructive operation, and workloads must stay available throughout the procedure.
